## Offline supplier-row review demo
All suppliers and responses are invented. No credentials, community node or network request. Inspect Supplier review register after execution. This output is not a saved spreadsheet or external register.

Stable list/supplier/revision keys; identical duplicates skip; conflicting duplicates fail; shared faults stop further attempts. No supplier is automatically approved.
